_comment: Agent profiles for the delegation broker (track 1, 1.5 - 1.8). A profile is how an agent is registered: its name and its ceiling, set by an administrator and never by the model. Changing a ceiling is a privilege grant: review it as one, and update docs/architecture in the same change. The broker refuses to start if a ceiling names an unknown scope or refunds:approve. Each profile's credential is .secrets/broker_profile_<name with underscores>, mounted to the broker and the probe only.

profiles.name: status-helper
profiles.description: Answers 'where is my order?'. Reads orders and nothing else.

profiles.name: refund-assistant
profiles.description: Prepares a refund for a human to approve. Never approves one.
